config_fields.label: Callback URL
config_fields.description: The HTTPS URL events are delivered to. It must answer a verification challenge before the subscription is created.

config_fields.label: Principal
config_fields.description: The authenticated subject the subscription belongs to. Callback verification is cached per principal and URL.

config_fields.label: Arguments
config_fields.description: The subscription arguments, as canonical JSON. Stored with the subscription.

credential_fields.label: Secret
credential_fields.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret: whsec_ followed by base64 of 24 to 64 bytes.

credential_fields.label: Previous Secret
credential_fields.description: The secret rotated away from. Deliveries are also signed with it for 24 hours.

credential_fields.label: Previous Secret Expires At
credential_fields.description: When the previous secret stops signing deliveries, in RFC 3339 format.

label: MCP Events
description: Experimental. Deliver events to MCP Events webhook subscriptions.
